2609.31179.title: SPO: Discovering Adaptive Large Neighborhood Search Operators via Stackelberg Program Optimization
2609.31179.paper_summary: Large neighborhood search (LNS) relies critically on destroy and repair operators, whose effectiveness depends on both adaptation to the evolving LNS state and interaction between the two roles. We introduce Stackelberg Program Optimization (SPO), an LLM-based framework for discovering adaptive executable destroy-repair programs. SPO conditions operator decisions on a compact LNS state, allowing state-dependent behavior to emerge through program discovery, and organizes destroy-repair discovery as a Stackelberg interaction over program space that reflects their asymmetric dependency. Role-specific credits evaluate destroy programs as leaders and repair programs as conditional follower responses, guiding a coupled optimization process that combines LLM generator learning with population-based evolutionary search over programs. Experiments on the traveling salesperson problem and capacitated vehicle routing problem show that SPO outperforms strong baselines across a broad range of settings and generalizes beyond the discovery scale to larger instances and benchmark sets. Behavioral analyses further demonstrate state-dependent operator behavior and coupled destroy-repair improvement during discovery.
2609.31179.paper_summary_zh: 大型鄰域搜尋（LNS）在很大程度上依賴於破壞和修復運算子，其有效性取決於對不斷演變的 LNS 狀態的適應以及兩個角色之間的互動。<lb/>我們引入了 Stackelberg 程序優化（SPO），這是一個基於 LLM 的框架，用於發現自適應可執行的破壞-修復程序。<lb/>SPO 將運算子的決策條件化於一個緊湊的 LNS 狀態，允許通過程序發現出現狀態依賴行為，並將破壞-修復的發現組織為一個反映其不對稱依賴的 Stackelberg 互動。<lb/>角色特定的信用評估將破壞程序視為領導者，將修復程序視為條件跟隨者的反應，指導一個結合 LLM 生成器學習與基於種群的進化搜尋的耦合優化過程。<lb/>在旅行推銷員問題和有容量的車輛路由問題上的實驗表明，SPO 在廣泛的設置中超越了強基準，並且在發現規模之外對更大實例和基準集具有良好的泛化能力。<lb/>行為分析進一步展示了狀態依賴的運算子行為以及在發現過程中的耦合破壞-修復改進。
